request.subject: UNIT:DINOSAUR:RAIDER

layers.text: Change only the colours and remove the blanket: the red feather crest becomes bright amber-orange #f08c1e; the red blanket and its cord are removed, leaving bare hide. The hide becomes plain slate blue, colour #4f73a6, darker navy #26375c along the back and tail top, with no stripes; belly, throat and claws warm cream. Nothing red is left. Keep the head, eyes, teeth, legs, tail, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
